trial.enabled.description: Offer a free trial to accounts that never had one.

trial.plan_code.description: Code of the plan whose entitlements a trial grants.

subscription.grace_days.description: Days of continued access after a period ends without renewal.

devices.limit_without_subscription.description: Devices an account may register before subscribing.

reminders.days_before.description: Days before a non-renewing period ends to email a reminder.

access.invite_only.description: Closed test: paying or a trial requires having redeemed an invite (free-days) code.

games.enabled.description: Mini Games section and Jungle Kong Blackjack.

games.multiplayer_enabled.description: Tables for 2-4 players (off: the owner chose solo play only).

games.chips.enabled.description: Fun chips: stakes with no value (no purchase, no exchange) while bonus-day stakes are off. They make the biggest-win leaderboard work in fun mode.

games.chips.daily.description: Chips are topped up to this every day.

games.chips.stake_options.description: Chip stakes offered (multiples of 10, so 3:2, 6:5 and halves pay whole chips).

games.blackjack.stakes_enabled.description: Staking game bonus days. OFF by default: enable only after the legal check for your target countries. When off the game is for fun: nothing is won or lost.

games.blackjack.stake_options_days.description: Stakes a player can choose, in bonus days.

games.blackjack.daily_win_cap_days.description: A player who is this many bonus days up today can only play for fun until tomorrow.

games.blackjack.welcome_bonus_days.description: One-time game bonus for a new game profile while stakes are enabled (0 = none).

games.bonus_redeem_enabled.description: Players may turn whole game bonus days into VPN subscription days.

games.blackjack.turn_seconds.description: Time for a move at a shared table.

games.blackjack.bet_seconds.description: Time to join the next round at a shared table.

referrals.enabled.description: Referral program: discount for invited users, free days for referrers.

referrals.percent_off.description: Discount an invited user gets on their first payment.

referrals.milestones.description: Referral ranks (3/5/10/25 paying friends) with free days and app themes.

referrals.bonus_days.description: Free days for the referrer per invited user's first payment (0 = off).

peers.idle_ttl_hours.description: Take a peer off its node after this many hours without a handshake (0 = never). Keep 0 while users import a fixed config into the WireGuard app (Telegram version): that app doesn't ask us before connecting, so a removed peer would just stop working until the user taps Connect in the Mini App again.
